name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹5,00,000 free cashless health insurance cover per family per year
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering secondary and tertiary hospitalization care across 27,000+ empanelled hospitals.
key_benefits: ₹5 Lakhs per family per year cashless hospitalization coverage
Covers 1,949 medical procedures including surgeries, diagnostics, and medicines
No restriction on family size, age, or gender; pre-existing conditions covered from day one
Valid across all public and private empanelled hospitals nationwide
required_documents: Ration Card / BPL Certificate / PM-JAY Family Letter
application_process: Online (Portal) / CSC Center / Empanelled Hospital Helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
max_subsidy_or_loan: Direct DBT Cash Incentive of ₹5,000 (1st child) & ₹6,000 (2nd child if girl)
description: Maternity benefit programme providing conditional cash transfers to pregnant and lactating mothers for health checkups, institutional delivery, and nutritional support.
key_benefits: ₹5,000 in 2 installments for first living child upon ANC registration and institutional birth
Additional ₹6,000 incentive for second child if newborn is a girl
Compensates for wage loss and promotes institutional delivery and immunization
required_documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card / ANC Record
Bank / Post Office Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
application_process: Online (PMMVY Portal) / Anganwadi Centre / ASHA Worker

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
max_subsidy_or_loan: Up to ₹78,000 Direct Central Subsidy + Zero/Low Interest Solar Loan
subsidy_percentage: Up to 60% Central Government Subsidy on Solar Capital Cost
description: National rooftop solar scheme providing direct capital subsidies to 1 Crore households to install solar panels, providing up to 300 units of free electricity every month.
key_benefits: ₹30,000 subsidy for 1 kW system, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above
Save up to ₹15,000 - ₹25,000 annually on residential electricity bills
Collateral-free bank loans at concessional 7% repo-linked interest rate
Sell surplus power back to DISCOM via net-metering for passive monthly income
required_documents: Latest Electricity Bill showing consumer number
Bank Account details / Cancelled Cheque for direct subsidy credit
application_process: Online (National Portal for Rooftop Solar)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Parents of Girl Children under 10 years
max_subsidy_or_loan: Highest 8.2% Guaranteed Tax-Free Compound Interest (Triple EEE Tax Benefit)
subsidy_percentage: 8.2% Govt Sovereign Interest + 100% Tax Exemption under Sec 80C
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children as part of 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao', providing highest sovereign interest rates and full tax exemption for higher education and marriage.
key_benefits: High 8.2% annual compound interest guaranteed by Government of India
Triple EEE Tax Exemption: Deposit, Interest earned, and Maturity amount are 100% tax-free
Minimum deposit of just ₹250/year up to ₹1.5 Lakhs/year
50% partial withdrawal allowed when girl child reaches 18 for higher education
required_documents: Parent / Legal Guardian Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill / Passport / Voter ID)
application_process: Offline (Post Office / Any Nationalized or Private Commercial Bank)

name: ADIP Scheme - Assistance to Disabled Persons for Aids and Appliances
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
max_subsidy_or_loan: 100% Free Motorized Tricycles, Wheelchairs, Hearing Aids, Smart Canes & Prosthetics
subsidy_percentage: 100% Free Grant for income <= ₹1.8L; 50% subsidy for income <= ₹2.7L
description: Provides modern, durable, and standard assistive devices and appliances free of cost to promote physical, social, and psychological rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.
key_benefits: 100% free motorized tricycles, smart canes, Daisy players, Braille kits, and cochlear implants
Custom fitting and rehabilitation support at ALIMCO camps across all districts
Enables independent mobility, education, and dignified employment
required_documents: Disability Certificate / Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card showing 40%+ disability
application_process: Online (UDID Portal) / ALIMCO District Camps / District Social Welfare Office

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens from BPL / Vulnerable Households
max_subsidy_or_loan: Monthly Direct DBT Pension (₹1,000 - ₹3,000/month combined Central + State top-up)
description: National social assistance programme providing monthly non-contributory pensions to elderly citizens living below poverty line to ensure social security in old age.
key_benefits: Guaranteed monthly social security pension credited directly into senior citizen's bank account
Additional monthly pension increase upon reaching 80 years of age
Seamless linkage with Ayushman Bharat free healthcare cover
application_process: Online (NSAP Portal) / Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipal Office

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
max_subsidy_or_loan: Assured Minimum ₹3,000/Month Lifetime Pension post age 60 with 50% Govt matching contribution
subsidy_percentage: 50% Matching Contribution by Central Government into Pension Fund
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers whose monthly income is ₹15,000 or less, ensuring financial dignity in old age.
key_benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after reaching 60 years
50% matching monthly contribution deposited directly by Government of India
Nominee family pension of 50% to spouse in case of beneficiary's demise
required_documents: e-Shram Card / Self-Declaration of unorganised worker
Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Passbook with auto-debit consent
application_process: Online (Maan-dhan Portal) / Common Service Centre (CSC) / e-Shram portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹2,00,000 Accidental Death & Full Disability Insurance for just ₹20/year
description: Affordable national accidental death and disability insurance scheme providing immediate financial security to bank account holders.
key_benefits: ₹2,00,000 coverage for accidental death or permanent total disability
₹1,00,000 coverage for permanent partial disability
Nominal annual premium of just ₹20 auto-debited once a year from bank account
required_documents: Bank Account details with auto-debit facility enabled
application_process: Online (Netbanking) / Any Bank Branch / Post Office

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_beneficiaries: Adult Women from BPL / Poor Households without LPG connection
max_subsidy_or_loan: Free LPG Connection + Free Stove & 1st Cylinder + ₹300/cylinder ongoing DBT subsidy
subsidy_percentage: 100% Free Initial Connection + Ongoing ₹300 Targeted Cylinder Subsidy
description: Empowers rural and deprived women by providing deposit-free LPG connections, protecting health from hazardous smoke and cooking fuels.
key_benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder, regulator, safety hose, and gas stove free of cost
First refill cylinder provided completely free of charge
Ongoing ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder subsidy directly credited into bank account (up to 12 refills/yr)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members
Proof of address (Self-declaration for migrant families)
application_process: Online (PMUY Portal) / Nearest LPG Distributor (Indane / Bharatgas / HP Gas)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
max_subsidy_or_loan: 40% to 60% Capital Subsidy on Fishing Boats, Biofloc Ponds, Cages & Cold Chain
subsidy_percentage: 40% Subsidy for General Men / 60% Subsidy for SC/ST/Women
description: Flagship scheme to bring about Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development of fisheries sector across inland and marine domains.
key_benefits: Up to 60% financial assistance for new motorized boats, biofloc tanks, RAS, and hatcheries
Livelihood and nutritional support for traditional fishers during fishing ban/lean periods
Subsidized Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for working capital at 4% interest rate
required_documents: Fisherman ID Card / Registration Certificate / Land/Waterbody title
Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
application_process: Online (PMMSY Portal) / District Fisheries Department / Matsya Seva Kendra

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
max_subsidy_or_loan: 100% Free Foodgrains (5 kg rice/wheat per person per month / 35 kg per AAY family)
subsidy_percentage: 100% Free Foodgrains (Zero cost at Fair Price Shops)
description: World's largest food security welfare initiative providing free monthly foodgrains to 81.35 Crore beneficiaries under National Food Security Act (NFSA).
key_benefits: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month for Priority Households (PHH)
35 kg free foodgrain per family per month for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households
Nationwide portability under 'One Nation One Ration Card' (ONORC) using biometric Aadhaar e-PoS
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Biometric verification at Fair Price Shop (FPS)
application_process: Auto-Enrolled / Nearest Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop)

name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
max_subsidy_or_loan: Up to ₹50 Lakhs (Manufacturing) / ₹20 Lakhs (Service) with 15-35% Subsidy
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.

eligibility_rules.min_qualification: 8th Pass (for projects > ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing or > ₹5 Lakhs in service)

key_benefits: Bank-financed loan with up to 35% government capital subsidy
No collateral required for loans up to ₹10 Lakhs under CGTMSE
Free Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training
required_documents: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th Pass or higher)
Caste / Special Category Certificate (if claiming 25-35% subsidy)
Rural Area Certificate from Gram Panchayat / BDO (for rural subsidy)
application_process: Online (KVIC e-Portal)

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
max_subsidy_or_loan: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹20 Lakhs (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
key_benefits: Shishu: Up to ₹50,000 for early starters
Kishore: ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs for scaling businesses
Tarun & Tarun Plus: ₹5 Lakhs to ₹20 Lakhs for established enterprises
Zero collateral or third-party guarantee required
application_process: Online (Udyamimitra Portal) / Any Commercial Bank / NBFC

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
max_subsidy_or_loan: Composite Loan between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore
subsidy_percentage: Up to 85% project cost financing at concessional interest
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.

eligibility_rules.special_demographic: Must be either a Woman OR belong to SC/ST category (or 51% stake in enterprise)

key_benefits: Financing up to 85% of project cost (term loan + working capital)
Concessional base interest rate + minimum margin
Repayable in 7 years with a moratorium period of up to 18 months
required_documents: Caste Certificate (if applying under SC/ST category)
Proof of Enterprise ownership (51% shareholding for Women/SC/ST)
application_process: Online (Stand-Up Mitra Portal) / Bank Branch

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
max_subsidy_or_loan: Full tuition fee reimbursement + ₹13,500/year annual maintenance allowance
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to marginalized categories studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
key_benefits: 100% non-refundable compulsory course fee reimbursement directly to institution
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars
application_process: Online (National Scholarship Portal - NSP)

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹6,000 per year directly into bank account (3 equal installments of ₹2,000)
description: Central sector scheme that supplements financial needs of landholding farmers' families in procuring various inputs related to agriculture and domestic needs.

eligibility_rules.landholding: Cultivable agricultural landholding in own name

key_benefits: Direct financial support of ₹6,000 annually in 3 tranches
Seamless Aadhaar-seeded bank transfer without intermediaries
Eligibility for linked Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loans at 4% subsidized interest
required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni / 7/12 extract)
Active Bank Account seeded with Aadhaar
application_process: Online (PM-KISAN Portal) / CSC Center / Village Revenue Officer

name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
max_subsidy_or_loan: Graduated Working Capital Loan: ₹10,000 (1st Tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd)
subsidy_percentage: 7% Interest Subsidy + up to ₹1,200/year cashback on digital transactions
description: Special micro-credit facility for street vendors to restart their livelihoods post-pandemic, promoting formal financial inclusion and digital payments.

eligibility_rules.vending_activity: Engaged in street vending in urban/peri-urban areas

key_benefits: Zero collateral working capital loan starting at ₹10,000, stepping up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment
7% interest subsidy credited directly to borrower's account quarterly
Monthly digital cashback reward of up to ₹100 for digital payments
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / ID card issued by ULB or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_process: Online (PM SVANidhi Portal) / Urban Local Body / Common Service Center

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of MSME and Ministry of Skill Development
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹15,000 Tool Kit Grant + Collateral-free Enterprise Loan up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% interest
subsidy_percentage: ₹15,000 Free Toolkit Grant + 8% Interest Subvention (Net 5% interest)
description: End-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 designated trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Tailors, etc.).

eligibility_rules.traditional_trade: Engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades

key_benefits: Official PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card recognition
Basic skill training (5-7 days) & Advanced training (15+ days) with ₹500/day stipend
₹15,000 E-Voucher / grant for modern toolkit purchase
Collateral-free loan: ₹1 Lakh (1st tranche) + ₹2 Lakhs (2nd tranche) at low 5% interest
required_documents: Trade declaration / proof of engagement in designated craft
application_process: Online (PM Vishwakarma Portal) / Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
max_subsidy_or_loan: Up to ₹20 Lakhs Grant (Proof of Concept) + ₹50 Lakhs Debt/Convertible Debentures
subsidy_percentage: 100% Grant up to ₹20L for validation + Low interest debt up to ₹50L
description: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.

eligibility_rules.dpiit_recognition: DPIIT recognized startup incorporated within the last 2 years
eligibility_rules.business_innovation: Must have an innovative product/technology with market viability

key_benefits: Grant up to ₹20 Lakhs for Proof of Concept / Prototype / Product trials
Investment up to ₹50 Lakhs via convertible debentures or debt for commercialization
Incubation, mentorship, and testing lab infrastructure support
required_documents: Company PAN and Bank Account details
application_process: Online (Startup India Portal)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban / Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
max_subsidy_or_loan: Up to ₹2.67 Lakhs Interest Subsidy (CLSS) / ₹1.3 Lakhs Direct Housing Grant
subsidy_percentage: Credit Linked Interest Subsidy of 3% - 6.5% on home loans
description: Affordable pucca housing with basic amenities for economically weaker sections (EWS) and lower income groups (LIG) who do not own a pucca house.

eligibility_rules.pucca_house: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India

key_benefits: Up to ₹2.67 Lakhs upfront interest subsidy on home loans for first-time home buyers
Direct construction financial assistance of ₹1.20L to ₹1.30L for rural houses
Additional assistance for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit affirming no pucca house ownership in India
application_process: Online (PMAY Portal) / CSC Center / Gram Panchayat / Municipal Office

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹12,000/year for Graduation (3 yrs) + ₹20,000/year for Post-Graduation (2 yrs)
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families to pursue regular degree courses in recognized colleges and universities.
key_benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first 3 years of Undergraduate study
₹20,000 per annum for Postgraduate studies
Direct Benefit Transfer directly into student’s Aadhaar-linked savings account
required_documents: Current College Admission Letter & Student ID
application_process: Online (National Scholarship Portal - NSP)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
max_subsidy_or_loan: 100% Free Industry-Standard Skill Training + ₹8,000 Certification & Reward
description: Skill certification scheme enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that helps them in securing a better livelihood and employment.

eligibility_rules.min_qualification: School / College dropout or unemployed youth looking for vocational skills

key_benefits: Completely free short-term training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)
NSQF-aligned nationally and internationally recognized certificate
Direct placement assistance and Rozgar Mela access with leading corporate employers
application_process: Online (Skill India Digital Portal) / PMKVY Training Center

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
max_subsidy_or_loan: Monthly Stipend Subsidy up to ₹1,500/month (Direct DBT) + Employer Industry Stipend
subsidy_percentage: Govt covers 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500/mo directly via DBT
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by providing financial support to industrial establishments undertaking apprenticeships and direct stipend support to apprentices.

eligibility_rules.min_qualification: 5th / 8th / 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Graduate depending on trade

key_benefits: On-the-job hands-on industrial training with premier registered companies
Guaranteed monthly stipend (with government DBT component)
National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) upon completion
required_documents: Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
application_process: Online (Apprenticeship India Portal)

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
max_subsidy_or_loan: Revolving Fund & Bank Linkage Loan up to ₹10-20 Lakhs with 7% Subsidized Interest
subsidy_percentage: Interest Subvention bringing net interest rate down to 7% (and 4% for prompt repayment)
description: Alleviates rural poverty by building strong community institutions for rural poor women (SHGs) and facilitating access to sustainable livelihoods and financial services.
key_benefits: Revolving Fund (₹20,000 - ₹30,000) and Community Investment Fund (up to ₹1.5 Lakhs) per SHG
Collateral-free bank loan linkages up to ₹10-20 Lakhs per group
Livelihood skills training and market access for farm and non-farm rural products
application_process: Offline (Village Organization / Gram Panchayat / Block Mission Management Unit)

name: Khelo India - National Sports Talent Scholarship
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹5,00,000 per year annual financial assistance for 8 consecutive years
subsidy_percentage: 100% Fully Funded Elite Sports Training & Stipend
description: Revives sports culture at grassroots level in India by identifying talented youngsters and providing financial assistance and world-class training for international competitions.
key_benefits: Annual financial assistance of ₹5 Lakhs per year for 8 years to 1,000 selected athletes
Admission to state-of-the-art Khelo India State Centres of Excellence (KISCE)
High-performance coaching, nutrition, equipment, and international competition exposure
required_documents: Sports Achievement Certificate (District / State / National level)
Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
application_process: Online (Khelo India Portal) / Sports Authority of India (SAI) Talent Assessment

name: INSPIRE Fellowship (Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology (Department of Science and Technology)
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹37,000 - ₹42,000/month JRF/SRF Fellowship + ₹20,000/year Annual Contingency Grant
description: Attracts talent to study science and pursue careers in scientific research, offering full financial support to top rankers in Basic & Applied Sciences at Bachelor, Master, and Ph.D. levels.
key_benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) @ ₹37,000/month for first two years
Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) @ ₹42,000/month for next three years
Annual contingency grant of ₹20,000/year for books, conferences, and consumables
required_documents: M.Sc / Integrated M.S. Degree Marksheet and University 1st Rank / INSPIRE Certificate
Ph.D. Admission / Enrolment Letter in recognized Indian University/Institute
application_process: Online (DST INSPIRE Portal)

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Veteran Artists
ministry: Ministry of Culture
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹6,000 per month lifetime financial pension assistance
description: Provides monthly financial assistance to veteran artists and cultural workers aged 60+ who have contributed significantly to traditional arts and literature but face penury.
key_benefits: Lifetime monthly pension of ₹6,000 directly into beneficiary's bank account
Provision for continuation of pension to spouse upon the demise of the veteran artist
Honors life-long contribution to preserving India's tangible and intangible cultural heritage
required_documents: Proof of contribution to Art & Culture (Certificates, press clippings, recommendation from State Culture Dept)
application_process: Online (CSMS Portal - Ministry of Culture)

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
ministry: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance coverage per family per year
description: Flagship health assurance scheme of Maharashtra providing ₹5 Lakhs cashless treatment for 1,356 identified medical and surgical procedures across 1,000+ empanelled hospitals.
key_benefits: ₹5,00,000 annual cashless coverage per family across empanelled network hospitals
Covers 1,356 medical and surgical therapies including oncology, cardiology, nephrology, and trauma care
Universal health coverage for all ration card holders of Maharashtra
Pre and post hospitalization medicine and diagnostic expenses included
required_documents: Maharashtra Ration Card (Yellow / Orange / White) or Domicile Certificate
application_process: Empanelled Hospital Helpdesk (Arogyamitra) / Online Portal

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Women of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per year) direct bank transfer
description: Empowers underprivileged women across Maharashtra by providing ₹1,500 monthly direct financial assistance to promote health, nutrition, and financial independence.
key_benefits: ₹1,500 monthly direct benefit transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Enhances financial self-reliance and nutrition security for women
Simple paperless digital verification via Nari Shakti Doot App
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / Ration Card issued before 15 years
Income Certificate (Annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card
application_process: Online (Nari Shakti Doot App / MahaDBT Portal) / Anganwadi / Setu Suvidha Kendra

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
ministry: Department of Skills, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Job seekers and youth aged 18 to 35 years in Maharashtra
max_subsidy_or_loan: Monthly stipend up to ₹10,000 for 6 months (Total ₹60,000)
description: Provides practical on-the-job training and paid industrial internship for educated youth in Maharashtra with monthly stipends of ₹6,000 (12th pass), ₹8,000 (Diploma/ITI), and ₹10,000 (Graduates).
key_benefits: ₹6,000/mo for 12th Pass, ₹8,000/mo for ITI/Diploma, ₹10,000/mo for Degree/PG holders
6 months industry internship and work experience certificate
Direct recruitment opportunities in participating industrial establishments
application_process: Online (MahaSwayam Portal)

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000 per year) unconditional cash transfer
description: Karnataka's landmark welfare program granting ₹2,000 monthly cash assistance to woman head of every eligible family (Antyodaya, BPL, and APL ration card holders).
key_benefits: ₹2,000 monthly guaranteed cash assistance deposited via DBT
Covers over 1.1 crore women heads of household in Karnataka
Women lead financial decisions for household well-being
application_process: Online (Seva Sindhu Portal) / Karnataka One / Grama One Centers

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed Degree and Diploma graduates in Karnataka
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹3,000/mo for Graduates, ₹1,500/mo for Diploma holders for 2 years (Up to ₹72,000)
description: Provides financial security and skill development for unemployed youth in Karnataka who graduated and have remained unemployed for at least 6 months.
key_benefits: ₹3,000 per month for degree holders for up to 2 years or until employed
₹1,500 per month for diploma holders for up to 2 years
Free access to government skill development and job matching programs
required_documents: Karnataka Domicile / Study Certificate (minimum 6 years in Karnataka)
application_process: Online (Seva Sindhu Portal)

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Low-income resident families of Tamil Nadu
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance cover per family per year
description: Comprehensive health protection scheme by Tamil Nadu government offering ₹5 Lakhs cashless medical and surgical treatment across 1,500+ procedures in empanelled hospitals.
key_benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care
Covers 1,513 procedures, 52 diagnostic procedures, and 8 follow-up packages
Includes dedicated corpus fund for specialized high-cost surgeries (organ transplants, cochlear implants)
required_documents: Income Certificate (<= ₹1.20 Lakhs per annum from VAO / Revenue Inspector)
application_process: District Kiosk (Collectorate) / Empanelled Hospital Helpdesk

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Female students who studied 6th to 12th in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹1,000 per month financial aid throughout undergraduate degree / diploma
description: Incentivizes girl students from government schools to pursue higher education (Undergraduate degrees, Engineering, Medicine, Diploma, ITI) with ₹1,000 monthly bank transfer.
key_benefits: ₹1,000 deposited every month into beneficiary's bank account till graduation

max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance coverage per family per year

key_benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless cover per family per year (up to 5 family members per card)
Free for BPL, street vendors, and divyangjan; nominal annual fee for others
Empanelled network includes AIIMS Bilaspur, IGMC Shimla, RPGMC Tanda, and PGI Chandigarh
application_process: Online (HIMCARE Portal) / LokMitra Kendra

name: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY - Goa)
ministry: Directorate of Health Services, Government of Goa
target_beneficiaries: Resident families living in Goa for 5+ years
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹4,00,000 cashless health insurance cover per family per year
description: Universal health insurance scheme in Goa offering ₹4 Lakhs (family of 4+) or ₹2.5 Lakhs (family of up to 3) annual cashless coverage for 447 medical procedures in empanelled hospitals.
key_benefits: ₹4,00,000 annual cashless coverage for family of 4 or more; ₹2,50,000 for small families
Covers 447 medical procedures, surgeries, ICU hospitalization, and prosthetics
Covers all residents residing in Goa for 5 years or more

name: Griha Aadhar Scheme (Goa)
ministry: Directorate of Women and Child Development, Government of Goa
target_beneficiaries: Homemakers and women from families with income under ₹3 Lakhs in Goa
max_subsidy_or_loan: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 per year) direct financial support
description: Provides ₹1,500 monthly financial assistance directly into the bank accounts of homemakers in Goa to counter inflation and maintain household nutritional security.
key_benefits: ₹1,500 monthly direct financial assistance to housewives and homemakers
Protects low- and middle-income families from kitchen inflation
Direct digital bank credit

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G Housing for All)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Houseless families and households living in Kutcha / dilapidated houses in rural India

description: Flagship national rural housing mission providing direct grant of ₹1.20 Lakhs (plain areas) and ₹1.30 Lakhs (hilly/NE states) directly to family bank accounts to construct a minimum 25 sq.m hygienic pucca house.
key_benefits: ₹1,20,000 (plains) / ₹1,30,000 (hilly/IAP districts) direct financial assistance in 3 installments
₹26,000 additional wage support for 90-95 person days of un-skilled labour under MGNREGA
₹12,000 dedicated Swachh Bharat Mission grant for toilet construction + free LPG connection via Ujjwala
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
SECC / Awas+ Household Registration Number or Ration Card
Bank Account linked with Aadhaar & Mobile
Geo-tagged photograph of existing Kutcha house / land site
application_process: Gram Sabha / Block Development Officer / AwasApp / PMAY-G Portal

name: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey & Legal Property Titles for Rural Families)
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
target_beneficiaries: Rural families owning inhabited residential land (Abadi area) across all Indian villages
max_subsidy_or_loan: Free high-precision drone mapping & official legal 'Property Card' (Sampatti Patra)
description: Revolutionary central scheme deploying high-resolution drone mapping to provide village household families with official legal property cards (Ghar Ka Patta), enabling bank loans, property monetization, and zero land disputes.
key_benefits: Official digital Property Card (Sampatti Patra) conferring unassailable legal title to village home and land
Enables village families to use residential property as financial asset / collateral for bank loans
Accurate drone demarcation eliminates boundary disputes with centimeter-level GPS precision
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Head of Household
Gram Panchayat tax receipt / Chulha tax / electricity bill
application_process: Survey of India village survey / Gram Panchayat validation

Includes piped drinking water, underground drainage, and electricity connection in YSR Jagananna layouts

name: Mission Basundhara (Land Rights & Homestead Settlement for Landless Families)
ministry: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Assam

Protects indigenous and landless families from eviction and land tenure insecurity
100% digital transparent application through Sewa Setu / Basundhara portal

Automatic linkage with Biju Pucca Ghar / PMAY housing assistance

ministry: Housing Department, Government of Karnataka

₹1,50,000 (General/OBC) or ₹1,75,000 (SC/ST) direct financial assistance via DBT
GPS geo-tagged stage-wise digital payments linked with beneficiary Aadhaar

name: Forest Rights Act (FRA) Individual & Community Land Titles
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs

description: Historic national legislation legally recognizing and vesting heritable ownership land titles/pattas up to 4 hectares for forest-dwelling Scheduled Tribes and traditional forest dwelling families.
key_benefits: Permanent legal land ownership title (Patta) over self-cultivated forest land up to 4 hectares
Joint title registered in the names of husband and wife with full heritable rights
Entitles family to government farm subsidies, crop insurance, PM-KISAN, and irrigation borewells
